query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM animalOwnerships WHERE animalId IN (SELECT id FROM animals WHERE ownerOpenId LIKE 'buyer-%')) as buyer_ownerships,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM animalPhotos WHERE ownerOpenId LIKE 'buyer-%') as buyer_photos,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM walletTransactions WHERE ownerOpenId LIKE 'buyer-%') as buyer_wallet,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM families WHERE ownerOpenId LIKE 'buyer-%') as buyer_families,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM partnerLeads WHERE ownerOpenId LIKE 'buyer-%') as buyer_leads;
